items.stem: Which StarBridge table holds one row per processed record with its outcome?
items.explanation: EntityTransaction records each processed record and its Outcome.

misconceptions.b: EntityValueChange holds the field-level diffs, not the per-record outcome.

items.stem: How is the transaction Outcome stored in EntityTransaction?

options.text: It isn't stored — only printed to the console

items.explanation: Outcome is an integer 1-11 mapping to the EntityTransactionOutcome enum (L1.10).

misconceptions.b: You filter on the integer (e.g. Outcome = 11), not the name string.

items.stem: To list every record that threw an exception, you filter EntityTransaction on which Outcome value?
items.explanation: 11 = ExceptionThrown. (2 = Rejected is 'try again later', not an error.)

misconceptions.a: Rejected (2) isn't an exception; it's a deferred-processing outcome.

items.stem: You need 'what field changed, from what value to what value' for an entity. Where do you look?
items.explanation: EntityValueChange holds the field-level diffs; EntityTransaction only says what happened to the record overall.

misconceptions.b: Outcome tells you the record was merged/created/etc., not which fields changed.

items.stem: Last night's run threw some exceptions. Which StarBridge tables/columns give you (a) which records threw and (b) the actual error text?
rubric: (a) EntityTransaction filtered to Outcome = 11 identifies which records threw
(b) The error text lives in Operation/Message (joined via OperationMessage), not in EntityTransaction
items.sampleAnswer: EntityTransaction with Outcome = 11 tells me which records threw. The message text isn't there — it's in the Operation/Message tables (joined through OperationMessage), which the ExceptionRejections script surfaces.
